section_header: BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM — Cruise Control System
title: CRUISE CONTROL SYSTEM Wiring Diagram

content.description: Complete wiring diagram for cruise control system showing connections between ignition switch, ECU, actuator, speed sensor, various switches (parking brake, clutch, stop light, main, control), and other components. The diagram includes fuse ratings (ECU Fuse 15A, GAUGE Fuse 7.5A, Stop Fuse 15A) and ground connections. All components are interconnected with numbered circuit points.
Connector pin diagrams showing the terminal layouts for various switches and sensors in the cruise control system

content.text: Parking Brake Switch - 2 pin connector shown with pins 1 and 2
Clutch Switch - 2 pin connector shown with pins 1 and 2
Stop Light Switch - 2 pin connector shown with pins 1 and 2
Cruise Control Computer - 11 pin connector with pins labeled: 6, 5, 4, Y, Z, 3, 2, 1, G, 12, 13, 10, 9, 8, 7
Main Switch - 6 pin connector shown with pins 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
Control Switch - Multi-pin connector labeled with terminals 26, 25, 23
Actuator - 3 pin connector shown with pins 1, 3, 2
Neutral Start Switch - 3 pin connector shown with pins 1, 2, 3
Speed Sensor (Analog Meter) - Connector showing terminals C-7 and C-6
Speed Sensor (Digital Meter) - Connector showing terminals A-12 and A-10
Large multi-pin connector diagram at bottom showing pins: 17, 16, 18, 10, 6, 5, 4, 2, 1, 12, 13, 20, 19, 11, 9, 8, 7
